chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Panassie's invitation and Bishop's tearful boarding
summary: Panassie had invited them, and Clayton, who learned French in New York, sailed with Bishop weeping over his wife.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: On trombone. So we always said, we want to go to Europe. Bishop was

having trouble with his wife. She was putting him down. So we all saved up enough money and caught the Isle de France and went over there. But before we went Paradisio has been to New York, he came to New York somewhere down in that time.

And he told us he said if you ever get to France just let me know and I'll arrange something for you. And we always kept that in our minds you know, because we met him at the boat and we played a lot of things for him and Mezzrow was here then, Sidney Bechet Happy Caldwell, Jack Butler, a lot of them.
We all met him at the boat and we made him kind of happy to be in the States, it was his first trip. So he said, if you ever get to Europe and I was learning to speak French at that time,
In New York. Because I knew, I had it in my mind I was going to go to France. I didn't know when.
Yes. I learned to read it and write it. So when we got or the boat, we had trouble getting Bishop on the boat because he kept

looking for his wife to say goodbye, she didn't say goodbye. And they almost pulled up the gang plank. And when he did get in on the boat he just boo-hooed all over the place, cried because this girl he had met when he was with Earl Hines worked with him in the Grande Terrace and she was working in the Savanah Club with my wife. But she didn't like Bishop no more and he still was inlove with her.

So just as they were about to pull the gang plank up he jumped on it, came on in and we went to France. But we had a nice ride over there. A very nice ride. It was only a four day ride. Not like China because it took me three weeks to ride to China.
